title: machaerium spinosum
intro: Machaerium spinosum, commonly known as the spiny machaerium, is a plant species of the Fabaceae family. It is a climbing vine native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The health benefits of Machaerium spinosum include its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, inflammation, and infections. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties.
